entry.name: xbendin
entry.digest: Interpret extra precision MIDI pitch bend values
entry.description: Acts as a 14-bit pitch bend filter/processor and xbendin2 serves as a 2-byte pitch bend filter/processor.

arguments.name: channel
arguments.description: The number specifies a MIDI channel on which to recognize pitch bend messages. If there is no argument,recognizes pitch bend messages on all channels, and the channel number is sent out the extra outlet on the right.

arguments.name: xbendin2
arguments.description: Normally,sends pitch bend values out the left outlet as 14-bit values. If the object is called, however, there will be an additional outlet. The most significant data byte of the message is sent out the leftmost outlet, and the least significant data byte is sent out the second outlet.

messages.description: The numbers are individual bytes of a MIDI message stream, received from an object such asor. MIDI pitch bend messages are recognized by, and the pitch bend data is sent out in full precision.
